data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 – refund of €888
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterstadt-Nord issued the 2025 income tax assessment on 27 April 2026. Tax is set at €8,214.00, and after €9,102.00 of withheld wage tax you get a refund of €888.00.
data.explanation: This is your final income tax assessment (Steuerbescheid) for 2025. Because more wage tax was withheld than due, the tax office will transfer €888 to the bank account named in the letter. The home office costs were only allowed at the flat rate (Homeoffice-Pauschale). If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office; the app shows until when. Otherwise the assessment becomes final. Keep the letter, and consider asking a tax adviser if you want to challenge the home office treatment.
data.tax_note: Income tax assessment for 2025; keep as proof of assessed income and tax, and for any later applications.

items.title: Object to the assessment (optional)
items.action: If you disagree with the assessment, file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, electronically, or by declaration at the tax office.
items.consequence: After the deadline the assessment becomes final and can no longer be challenged by objection.
